meta.title: Privacy requests
meta.description: FOA's grievance officer answers people's requests to see, correct or erase their data.

adminGrievance.title: Privacy requests
adminGrievance.lead: Requests to see, correct or erase personal data, earliest due first. Each needs an answer by its due date.

denied.title: Only the grievance officer can open this
denied.body: Your account doesn't have the grievance officer role. Privacy requests are answered by FOA's grievance officer.

empty.mine: No open requests are assigned to you.

table.caption: Privacy requests: {view, select, open {open} mine {assigned to you} unassigned {unassigned} other {closed}}

due.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Due today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
due.late: {days, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}

meta.title: Privacy request
meta.description: One privacy request, for the grievance officer.

request.title: Request {reference}

notFound.title: There is no such request
notFound.body: It may have been deleted after its retention period.

request.correction: What they asked us to correct

actions.title: Next step
actions.none: This request is closed, so it can't move on. Notes can still be added.

start.title: Start
start.body: Take this request yourself. The requester can't cancel it after this.

reject.title: Refuse
reject.reason: Why it can't be carried out
reject.hint: The requester reads this. Up to 1,000 characters. Don't name anyone else.

complete.title: Complete the correction
complete.hint: Correct the record on its own admin page first, then say what you changed. The requester reads this. Up to 2,000 characters.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.lead: Only grievance officers see these. They can't be edited.
notes.label: Add a note

export.title: Copy of the data
export.lead: Builds a file of everything FOA keeps about the person. Only the requester can download it; you never see it.
export.preparing: The copy is being prepared. The request completes when it's ready.
export.ready: The copy is ready for the requester.
export.expired: The copy's download has expired and the copy is deleted.

erasure.title: Erasure
erasure.lead: Check what erasing would delete, anonymise and keep. Carrying it out can't be undone.
erasure.caption: What erasure would do with each kind of record
erasure.disabled: Carrying out erasures is switched off until FOA's lawyer confirms what an erasure must keep (setting “Erase data on request”).
erasure.notStarted: Start the request before carrying out the erasure.
erasure.approved: Approved. The erasure runs in the background; this page shows the result when it's done.

failures.plan_changed: The records changed after the erasure was approved, so it could not finish. Check the plan again and approve it.
failures.erasure_disabled: Erasures were switched off before this one ran. It didn't run.

categories.directory_listings: Directory listings owned by the subject
categories.kept_profile: Participant profile with a paid registration
categories.donation_records: Donation, receipt and recurring mandate records
categories.volunteer_service: Volunteer assignments, hours and service certificates
categories.community_history: Community membership and private engagement history

bases.financial_floor: Financial records: 8 years after the financial year
bases.linked_records: Other records still name the account
bases.separate_subject: Each child is a separate person

results.unchanged: It was already assigned to them.
results.rejected: The request is refused. The requester has been told.
results.completed: The correction is recorded. The requester has been told.
results.erasure: The erasure is approved and will run shortly.

errors.invalid_input: Fill in the form: a reason, a note or a description can't be empty or too long.
errors.already_in_progress: This request is already in progress.
errors.assignee_not_officer: Only a grievance officer can be assigned.
errors.completed_by_export_or_erasure: This request completes by its copy of the data or its erasure.
errors.not_access: This isn't a request for a copy of the data.
errors.already_requested: The copy has already been asked for.
errors.erasure_disabled: Carrying out erasures is switched off.
errors.plan_changed: The records changed since you looked. Check the plan again.
